topic3.title: HOW TO PURCHASE
topic3.a1: We've adopted the bidding-up system. Current price is the current maximum bidding price. The bid increment is 1,000yen-5,000yen, which differs from vehicle to vehicle. Or you can place your maximu price, and the system will place bids automatically.
topic3.q2: I want to buy a vehicle on the stock list.
topic3.a2: There are two sales methods, Stock and Tender. Stock: The customer who offered the list price first can purchase it. Tender: Customers who offer the highest price above the list price (minimum winning bid) can purchase.
topic3.q3: I want to buy an ASK vehicle.
topic3.a3: The selling price and timing are not decided. We will put this vehicle on auction in about 2 weeks. Please put it into your 'Bookmark', if you are interested in it.We will send an automatic mail to you when the vehicle goes on sale.
topic3.q4: What is CHANCE AUCTION CHANCE TENDER?
topic3.a4: bid by the customer. In addition, bid (successful bid) cannot be canceled. CHANCE AUTION: The customer who wins the auction can be the purchase right holder. CHANCE TENDER: The customer whose offer price is highest can be the purchase right holder.
topic3.q5: Can I cancel my bid? I placed it by mistake.
topic3.a5: You cannot cancel your bid, once you place it. Check carefully vehicle information and all other charges before placing a bid. Cancellation penalty is charged on you, if you cancel your purchase.

topic4.title: BIDS & OFFERS
topic4.q1: Where can I find if I am the first in the auction?
topic4.a1: Login -> My Page -> MY AUCTION -> MY AUCTION(IN PROCESS) -> in process If a crown mark is displayed, you are in the first place. This page is not updated automatically, so please update it manually to view it.
topic4.q2: I want to directly negotiate and purchase a vehicle that did not reach the minimum bid.
topic4.a2: Only the customer who bids the highest bid at the end of the auction can negotiate within 3 hours after the end of the auction. The Business negotiation button will be displayed in the auction history on My Page. Click it and enter your desired purchase price.  Login -> My Page -> MY AUCTION -> finished -> OFFER button->input your desired price->CONFIRM button
topic4.q3: I want to determine if the minimum bid has been reached during the auction.
topic4.a3: If the minimum bid amount has been reached, Reached the reserved price will be displayed in red at the bottom of the car body amount on the bid screen.
topic4.q4: How can I know if I make a successful bid?
topic4.a4: If you win a car, the car's name will be posted on the following page for 90 days.Login -> My Page -> MY AUCTION -> finishedYou will also receive an automatic email with the winning bid amount.
topic4.q5: I want to know about auction extension.
topic4.a5: If there is a bid 5 minutes before the end time of the auction, the auction time will be automatically extended by 3 minutes. (There are also exceptions.)
topic4.q7: I would like to know how much a vehicle I wanted to buy sold for.
topic4.a7: You can check winning bid price in the following steps, only if you have made bids for the vehiclex.Login -> My Page -> MY AUCTION -> finished

topic5.title: PAYMENT
topic5.a1: As soon as it is issued, it will be available from the following.
topic5.q2: I want to know about the payment deadline.
topic5.a2: The payment deadline comes in 2 business days after the purchase. If you are late, payment delay penalty of 10.000 yen will be charged on you. If the product price does not arrive within 7 business days, the sales contract will be canceled and a cancellation penalty will be incurred. * Cancellation penalty amount Products with unit price of below 1,000,000 JPY: 100,000 yen Products with unit price of 1,000,000 yen or higher: 10% of the unit price
topic5.q3: What should I do if payment is likely to be delayed?
topic5.a3: Please call us as soon as you know that you will be late.
topic5.q4: I want to know the bank account information.
topic5.a4: It is written on the invoice.
topic5.q5: Are there any payment methods other than bank transfer?
topic5.a5: You can pay with PayPal (up to 200,000 yen) or Bitcoin.  Please contact us for details.

topic6.title: DELIVERY & PICK-UP OF VEHICLES
topic6.q1: I want to know the location of the service center where the vehicles are stored.
topic6.a1: Please see for the location of each service center.The detailed address can be found on the pick-up notification of each vehicle.
topic6.q2: I want to check inland delivery cost.
topic6.a2: You can check inland delivery cost.  Please contact us if you want to know delivery costs for trucks, motorcycles and other products. You can also check delivery cost on the bid (offer) page.
topic6.q3: Is reservation required when I'd like to pick up my cars?
topic6.a3: Required. Reservations can only be made during the reservation acceptance period. Please use the WEB reservation. Reservation acceptance period: From the completion of delivery preparation to 11:45AM (Japan time) the day before the scheduled pick-up date.
topic6.q4: How can I get a Vehicle pickup notification of my car?
topic6.a4: You can find Pick Up notification button on the right side of the relevant vehicle name. Login -> My Page -> PURCHASE HISTORY.
topic6.q5: Is there any deadline for pick-up of vehicles?
topic6.a5: Pick up your vehicle in 5 business days (if it's a truck, then 10 business days) after payment confirmation date. Otherwise there is pick-up delay penalty of 10,000yen every 5 business days after the deadline is over.
topic6.q6: When will my vehicle come to my yard?
topic6.a6: Delivery might be delayed due to traffic. Please make an inquiry individually.

topic7.title: OVERSEAS SHIPPING SERVICE
topic7.q1: When is the estimated departure date of my vehicle?
topic7.a1: We'll start to do delivery/ shipipng procedures after we confirm payment in our account.You can check shipping schedule from Login -> My Page -> PURCHASE HISTORY -> Delivery/ Shipping Details
topic7.q2: When will bill of lading (BL) be sent?
topic7.a2: About in a week after your vessel (container) leaves Japan.
topic7.q3: Can I use shipping service for a truck?
topic7.a3: It depends on size and condition of the truck. Make an inquiry so we'll make a quote for shipping charges.

topic8.title: OTHERS
topic8.q1: I want to know about Review.
topic8.a1: You can post a review of your purchased vehicle. ・ Delivery of vehicles less than 6 months. ・ Comments to be 35 characters long or more. ・ Share the photos took by your side .
